definitions.explanation: A red flag used as a signal, especially to warn of danger or to stop traffic, races, or swimming. Also a long-standing symbol of socialist and communist movements.

examples.japanese: {赤旗|あかはた}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{振|ふ}られた→振る：01983_furu⟧。
{踏切|ふみき}りで⟦{係員|かかりいん}→係員：27111_kakariin⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{赤旗|あかはた}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{出|だ}した→出す：01087_dasu⟧。
examples.english: An attendant raised a red flag at the railroad crossing.

examples.japanese: ⟦{高波|たかなみ}→高波：19938_takanami⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧、⟦{海水浴場|かいすいよくじょう}→海水浴場：21009_kaisuiyokujou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{赤旗|あかはた}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{立|た}てられた→立てる：01196_tateru⟧。
examples.english: Because of the high waves, a red flag was raised at the beach.

notes:
A red flag signals danger or a command to stop. Contrast with the white or green flag that signals safety.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {赤旗|あかはた}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{振|ふ}る→振る：01983_furu⟧: to wave a red flag
- {赤旗|あかはた}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{立|た}つ→立つ：00758_tatsu⟧: a red flag is raised

USAGE:
When read せっき, the same characters name the Japanese Communist Party's newspaper. The everyday reading for a physical warning flag is あか⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧た.
